content:
Ravi Kapoor: Quick heads-up: roll for feature branch runtime v4.3.2 in 10m. Canary 5% -> 25%.
Talia Brooks: Pin canary to v4.3.2; rollback target v4.3.1. We're prioritizing human check for first 12m.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Rolling canary to 5% for v4.3.2. Auto-revert suppressed per request.
ops-oncall: Who owns revert authority?
Ravi Kapoor: ops-oncall has authority for immediate reverts. Engineering (Talia) standby.
Nora Finch: Add explicit gate: if deploybot reports kernel-fallback >2 OR p95 delta >150ms for 3m -> hold.
Talia Brooks: Also, if function-level error spikes on embeddings-route, escalate to engineering immediately.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: p95=118ms, error_rate=0.01%, kernel-fallback=0.
ops-oncall: Monitoring.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics (2m): p95=260ms, kernel-fallback=1. Alert: p95 threshold breach.
Nora Finch: Trace shows fallback on worker-14 causing queuing.
ops-oncall: Pausing promotion. Given kernel fallback evidence + p95 breach, executing manual canary revert now.
ops-oncall: Running:
```
/ops/release revert --to v4.3.1 --scope canary --confirm
```
deploy-bot: Revert initiated. Shifting traffic off v4.3.2.
ops-oncall: Revert complete. Canary back to v4.3.1. p95 recovered to 120ms.
Ravi Kapoor: Thanks. Talia, please hold release notes and open a runtime ticket with traces. We'll reattempt after a patch.
Talia Brooks: On it. Drafting note: "canary paused due to performance regression; no wider impact." Will post after review. :thumbsup:
